metadata.frequency_unit: complete directed circuits/week in EACH orientation; each triangle yields 6*f one-way departures/week
metadata.airport_scope: MOW is a pooled city market at SVO coordinates, not an approved operating/billing airport.
metadata.capacity: 100 seats SSJ95B proxy; SJ100/PD8 economics not independently calibrated; no entry before H2 2027
metadata.annualization: Weekly seasonal means * scenario W * 7/12 or 5/12. W=52 base,48 cautious; not 365/7; not 48/52 demand scaling.
metadata.budget_boundary: Existing variable costs, crew/MRO proxies and own fare forgone retained. Lease/purchase excluded from MAIN by user; financing separately UNKNOWN_NOT_ZERO. Station/IT/insurance/launch/cash additions belong to budget assembly.

joint_OD_proof.invariant: Every endpoint journey is in exactly one offered OD set; hub segments=local+2*transfer; one transfer fare split over two spokes. Under source existing-direct + 1.35 circuity filter, OD sets are disjoint.
joint_OD_proof.own_migration: Only OMS-UUD in fixed offered OD has existing RW frequency. Old fare forgone is subtracted once for local migrated journeys. No transfer-OD own migration is present.
joint_OD_proof.scope_limit: Not a behavioural network-choice model. Latent substitution on excluded highly circuitous itineraries is assumed zero under the explicitly frozen filter, not empirically measured.
joint_OD_proof.shared_services: Do not add separate station/base fixed costs for shared GSV/MOW/VOG twice. Flight, passenger, ground proxy and BH costs add because events differ; negotiated station minimums/discounts are unknown.

physical_calendar: NOT_BUILT; no approved dates/slots/turns/rosters. Use api.runtime_calendar only for season-average scenario months after entry.
